statuses.ESTABLISHED: the registered criterion is met on the registered data
statuses.NOT_ESTABLISHED: the criterion is not met and the result is not a determinate failure; never equivalence
statuses.FAILED: the evidence determinately contradicts the hypothesis direction
statuses.INVALID: the analysis cannot support any status (integrity, binding, implementation or invalid-episode failure)
statuses.INCONCLUSIVE: the analysis ran but cannot discriminate (non-convergence, empty conditioning set, abstention)
statuses.NOT_AVAILABLE: required data or capability does not exist; nothing is substituted
statuses.EXPLORATORY: post-hoc or unregistered; never confirmatory evidence
statuses.ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT: the conclusion holds only under a stated untested assumption (fill bound, queue model, recovery failure)
statuses.MODEL_DEPENDENT: the conclusion changes sign or determinacy across plausible worlds
statuses.ROBUST_ACROSS_MODEL_UNCERTAINTY: only from the registered H8 robustness rule

rules: Exactly one primary status per result plus optional qualifiers.
NOT_AVAILABLE and INVALID require a reason.
Effect size and interval precede the status.
